summary: Victim was guided to use a fake wallet dashboard and advisor site that displayed a high balance while the real onchain address derived from the provided seed was already drained and a second displayed receiving address was not accessible to the victim
user_mistake: Trusted a third party wallet site and advisor interface that displayed balances not verifiable onchain
prevention: Verify balances and receiving addresses directly on a public block explorer and avoid wallet dashboards that cannot prove control of addresses
